# pve_cluster_join (Action)

Join this node to an existing cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "pve_cluster_join" "example" {
  config {
    fingerprint = "CHANGE_ME"
    hostname    = "CHANGE_ME"
    password    = "CHANGE_ME"
  }
}

# terraform_data is a no-op stand-in; wire action.pve actions to the
# lifecycle events of any managed resource.
resource "terraform_data" "trigger" {
  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create]
      actions = [action.pve_cluster_join.example]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `fingerprint` (String) Certificate SHA 256 fingerprint.
- `hostname` (String) Hostname (or IP) of an existing cluster member.
- `password` (String) Superuser (root) password of peer node.

### Optional

- `force` (Boolean) Do not throw error if node already exists.
- `link` (Block List) Corosync link of the node to join with; list position is the link number (up to link7). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--link))
- `nodeid` (Number) Node id for this node.
- `votes` (Number) Number of votes for this node

<a id="nestedblock--link"></a>
### Nested Schema for `link`

Required:

- `address` (String) Link address.

Optional:

- `priority` (Number) Link priority.
